title: Perovskite-Silicon Tandem Solar Cell with 33% Efficiency
abstract: A tandem photovoltaic device comprising a metal halide perovskite top cell on crystalline silicon heterojunction bottom cell exceeding 33% efficiency.
claims: A tandem solar cell comprising perovskite absorber FA0.8Cs0.2Pb(I0.6Br0.4)3 with thickness 400-600nm.
A recombination junction comprising 10nm tin oxide ETL and 10nm nickel oxide HTL.
Deposition by anti-solvent assisted spin coating followed by annealing at 100C.
problem_statement: Single-junction silicon cells limited to 29.4% by Shockley-Queisser limit.
